thread.document:
Overall, Claude performed well, 13/14 questions correct. It was strong at mathematical derivations(path counting induction proof), residual connections, and Newton Schulz convergence analysis. It provided a step by step reasoning which was clean and the explanations were well structured, and easy to follow. 

The one failure was Q3c(iii), where Claude had to write update equations for specific nodes in a graph. It confidently hallucinated the neighborhood structure, as I think it couldn't see the figure. Wrong neighbors led to wrong equations.
